messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — elevated generation latency observed for hosted-gen in eu-west-1. Error rate up ~7% for last 5m, tail latency spikes at ~5s. Investigating.

alice.m: Saw it, pulling logs now. Confirming scope: hosted API only or dedicated too?

oncall-bot: Initial signal: routing shows increased queue depth on fastgen-prod pool; dedicated pools OK so far.

ben.s: Repro steps? any obvious recent deploys?

alice.m: No deploys in last 30m. I'm dumping recent 502/504 traces and KV cache hit rates.

alice.m: Quick status page draft below, please check copy + customer impact. Need legal/translation check before publish.

alice.m: ```
Summary: We are investigating increased generation latency affecting text generation in eu-west-1. Some requests may experience delays up to ~5s or transient 5xx errors.
Impact: A subset of hosted API requests routed to fastgen-prod may see increased latency and occasional errors. Dedicated and private deployments are not impacted.
Mitigation: Traffic is being rebalanced to adjacent regions and a temporary throttle is in place while we investigate. We will post updates every 30 minutes.
ETA: ongoing investigation; next update in 30m.
```

eva.p: Copy looks good. Suggest clarifying "subset" -> approximate percent if available. Also request locale-ready strings for FR/DE.

ben.s: From traces: ~6% of requests in eu-west-1 impacted, concentrated on sequences >1k tokens. Adding that number helps.

alice.m: Updated draft with percent and token note. Pasting new copy below.

alice.m: ```
Summary: We are investigating increased generation latency affecting hosted text generation in eu-west-1. Approximately 6% of requests (primarily long sequences >1k tokens) may experience delays up to ~5s or transient 5xx errors.
Impact: Hosted API customers with traffic in eu-west-1 may see increased latency or errors. Dedicated and private deployments are not impacted.
Mitigation: We are rerouting new requests away from the affected pool and applying temporary throttles for very long sequences to reduce queueing.
Next steps: Continue root-cause analysis, consider kernel/queue tuning, and update every 30 minutes.
```

legal-bot: Quick legal check: wording OK. Recommend avoiding promising ETA, use "ongoing investigation" only. Also confirm we don't mention specific customers.

eva.p: Ack. I can start locale preparation for FR/DE/ES with short translations of the template.

alice.m: Thanks — I'll remove the ETA line and schedule publish. Who can publish to status page now? @ben.s?

ben.s: I can publish in 5m after we confirm final copy. Will add a note to the internal incident doc with mitigation steps.

alice.m: Publishing now — internal note will have diagnostic links and reroute config snippets.

ben.s: Published to status page (public). Internal update posted to #incidents-internal with links. :white_check_mark:

alice.m: Great. Next update will include any perf fix or fallback change. If anyone sees customer DMs or support trends, ping here and add examples (no customer identifiers).

oncall-bot: Reminder: auto-remind set for 30m for status update.

alice.m: Resolve notice draft once resolved: "Issue resolved. We mitigated elevated latency by rebalancing traffic and applying temporary throttles. Normal operations restored for eu-west-1. If you continue to see issues, contact support"

ben.s: Copy ok. I'll run post-mortem checklist after resolution and gather traces.

alice.m: Thanks all. Standby for updates. :eyes:
